title: Classic British Cottage Pie
description: A hearty, comforting dish made with ground beef, mushrooms, and a creamy topping.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a pan until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the mushrooms, onion, tomato paste, and beef broth to the pan and cook until the liquid has reduced.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Transfer the meat mixture to a 20x20cm baking dish.
Combine the cottage cheese and cheddar cheese in a bowl.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the top of the meat mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
